transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm... well, I'm having trouble keeping my mind on things. It's getting to the point where I can't stay focused long enough to finish what I need to do. Even important stuff. Like at work, I do computer support, and I'll start trying to trace a network issue for a client... and then ten minutes go by, and I realize I've just been looking at the same log entries over and over. I read them three times and still don't know what they actually say. It's just... not working.
Are you finding that these difficulties with focus are causing you a lot of distress?
I don't know about... distress. I guess it's just frustrating. I just need to be able to do my job.
Are you feeling anxious or overwhelmed by your work situation?
Not really. I mean... it's just a job. I wouldn't say I'm anxious. I just want to get my work done without it taking all day.
Do you find that you're having trouble remembering things that happened recently?
No. I mean... my memory is fine. I don't have trouble remembering things. It's just... what I said before.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless?

I guess so. I mean... if I'm sitting with a client, or at a chess meeting, my leg is usually bouncing. Or I'm clicking a pen. Sometimes I just twist a cable tie around in my fingers. I don't really notice I'm doing it until somebody finally gives me that look.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
No. I don't... I'm not sad. Just normal, I guess. I haven't really noticed feeling down or anything like that.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I don't think so. I mean... I usually know what I'm doing. I don't really just jump into things without a reason. So, no.
Do you often feel like you're constantly on the go, even when you're not at work?

I suppose. I mean... on my days off, I usually tell myself I'll just rest. But it doesn't really work out that way. I end up bouncing around. 

I'll start on a laptop repair, and then... I don't know, somehow I'm out messing with the garage shelves. Or I sit down to check a chess email, and next thing I know I'm reorganizing a box of cables. I just kind of move from one thing to another. And by the time it's night... nothing is really fully done.
Are you feeling upset or bothered by your inability to focus?
I don't know. I mean... it's just how it is. I wouldn't say I'm upset about it. It's just... frustrating sometimes, I guess. But I'm used to it.
Have you always had trouble focusing and been restless, or is this something that started happening more recently?

I guess it's... always been there. My mother still brings it up sometimes. She jokes about my old report cards from grade school. 

Apparently, the teachers always wrote that I was bright, but... I wouldn't stay in my seat. And I guess I blurted out answers a lot. I'd even lose my homework... even when I actually did it. So... yeah. It's not new.
Do you have trouble following through on instructions or finishing tasks at home, similar to what you described happening at work?
I guess... yeah. It's pretty much the same. I start things and then... I just don't finish them. Like I said before.
As a child, were you excessively physically active, such as running, climbing, or having difficulty playing quietly?
I don't really remember... I mean, I was a kid. Kids run around. I guess I was pretty active, but... I don't know if it was excessive. I just played like normal.
Do you have trouble staying focused at home, like when you're watching TV or reading a book?
I don't know... not really. I don't read a lot of books these days anyway. And TV is... it's just TV. I haven't really noticed a problem with it.
Did you often get into trouble for being overactive or restless as a child?

I suppose... maybe a little. My mother still jokes about it sometimes. She says my grade school report cards always said I was bright, but... that I never stayed in my seat. Or I'd blurt out answers. And... I guess I lost my homework a lot, even when I actually did it. So... yeah. I guess so.
Have you ever felt persistent feelings of irritability?
I... no, not really. I mean, things get on my nerves sometimes, just like anyone else. But... no, nothing persistent. I don't think so.
Have you ever had difficulty maintaining relationships with friends or family because of your restlessness or inability to focus?

Well... I don't know about friends or family so much. But... it's definitely caused problems with work. Since I lost my old job... the structure of it, I mean... things have been rough. I've lost some freelance clients. And I missed out on a senior service-manager role I was up for. My wife and I... we've had to worry about money lately. It's just... people don't seem to trust me to follow through on things right now. So... yeah. It's been hard.
Have you had difficulty maintaining friendships due to your restlessness or trouble focusing?
I... I think I just answered that. Like I said, it's mostly been work and... just the stress at home with the money. Not really friends.
Have you had difficulty maintaining a romantic relationship with your wife due to your restlessness or trouble focusing?

No, not really. I mean, we're stressed about the finances, like I said, but... we're fine. She's been supportive. It's just the money stuff causing tension, not... not my focus or anything like that. We're okay.
Have you ever lost a friend because of your difficulty staying focused or being restless?
No. I... I don't think so. Like I said, it's not really an issue with my friends.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?

Yeah, I do. Especially at work. If someone's explaining a tech issue, the answer usually just... jumps into my head. I end up talking over them or, you know, grabbing the keyboard before they're even done talking. I know I shouldn't, but... it happens.
